entities.name: Query HSP60
observations: 589 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 63.5 kDa and theoretical pI 5.52.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed Leishmania major mitochondrial chaperonin HSP60 Q94596.
Contains the Cpn60_TCP1/PF00118 domain at positions 37–543.
Homolog annotations support ATP-dependent protein folding and protein refolding in the mitochondrial matrix.

entities.name: Leishmania HSP60 Q94596
observations: Reviewed mitochondrial HSP60/chaperonin from Leishmania major; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated to mitochondrial matrix, ATP binding, ATP-dependent protein folding chaperone activity, and protein refolding.
Reference annotation describes roles in mitochondrial protein import, macromolecular assembly, and stress-associated refolding.

entities.name: Mitochondrial protein folding
observations: HSP60-dependent ATP-driven folding and refolding of imported or stress-destabilized proteins in the mitochondrial matrix.
Related processes include mitochondrial protein import and macromolecular assembly.

entities.name: HSP60 ATP-dependent folding activity
observations: Reference catalytic equation: ATP + H2O + unfolded polypeptide → ADP + phosphate + folded polypeptide.
ATP hydrolysis is coupled to chaperonin-mediated protein folding; the sequence analysis reports ATP-binding annotation.
